method: MCP browser (pwmcp-zonacnc) — navigate+resize+snapshot+DOM analysis at 1280/768/375px for Search Results Listing page grid/card layout + header/nav responsive behavior
anti_duplicate_note: Previous tests covered: homepage-to-category funnel (0745), CMS tables (0715), issue #675 verification (0700), EN i18n (0630), general responsive (0600), vendor/pricing (0445), PDP + search sidebar PR#645 (0915), Contact page (0930). THIS test: Exclusively focuses on Search Results Listing page (`/es/buscar`) product card (zcnc-listing-row) layout at 3 breakpoints + header/nav responsive behavior (Categorías toggle, Vender máquina icon, search icon)
scenario: Search Results Listing page (/es/buscar) responsive layout at 1280/768/375px — verifying listing-row card structure (image+info+price stacking), sidebar off-canvas behavior, header/nav element responsiveness, and tap target compliance

listing_layout.layout_type: 2-column flex (sidebar left | listing right), single-column listing rows

featured_card.note: Abus Vh656 has no product image

card_content_layout.desktop_1280: Image (240x180) + text side-by-side horizontally within zcnc-row-link
card_content_layout.mobile_375: Image (293x200) on top, info (293x166) below, price (293x34) at bottom — vertically stacked
card_content_layout.verdict: PASS — cards appropriately collapse from horizontal to vertical stack

featured_card_warning.first_listing_abus_vh656: No product image present — only country flag icon (16x11). All other 17 listings have proper product images at 240x180 (desktop) / 293x200 (mobile)
featured_card_warning.note: May be a listing-specific issue, not a responsive bug

listing_grid_responsive.list_display_mode: flex (single column row layout, NOT multi-column grid) — consistent across all breakpoints
listing_grid_responsive.text_overflow: No text overflow detected on titles or prices at any breakpoint

header_nav_responsive.desktop_nav: Full nav bar visible with Categorías dropdown, search, Vender máquina CTA, login

mobile_nav_375.categorias_link: Visible text button at (198, 33) — opens off-canvas categories panel
mobile_nav_375.mobile_menu_panel: Exists at x=-375 (off-screen off-canvas) with language selectors and contact info
mobile_nav_375.search_icon: 44x44 tap target — opens inline search bar
mobile_nav_375.hamburger_menu: DOM elements found (ps-mainmenu__mobile-toggle, menu-toggle) but hidden — 'Categorías' link serves as nav trigger

header_nav_responsive.verdict: PASS — nav collapses to mobile-optimized elements; no hamburger needed as Categorías link triggers off-canvas menu

horizontal_overflow.verdict: PASS — NO horizontal overflow at any tested breakpoint

categorias_link.recommendation: Increase Categorías button height from 37px to ≥44px for WCAG compliance

filtros_toggle_button.recommendation: Increase Filtros button height from 42px to ≥44px for full WCAG compliance

console_errors.pattern: Provider's accounts list is empty / FedCM get() rejects with NetworkError

notes: Search results listing cards collapse properly from horizontal (desktop) to vertical stack (mobile)
Zero horizontal overflow at all 3 breakpoints
Sidebar correctly switches to off-canvas (fixed, left:-320px) at ≤768px — PR #645 verified
Header nav elements resize appropriately for mobile: logo, Categorías text link, search/user icons (44x44), Vender máquina CTA (44x44)
No hamburger icon at mobile — Categorías link serves as primary nav trigger for off-canvas menu panel
First featured listing (Abus Vh656) missing product image at all breakpoints — may be listing-specific data issue, not responsive bug
Categorías tap target at 37px height < 44px WCAG minimum — MEDIUM severity
Filtros button tap target at 42px height < 44px WCAG minimum — LOW severity (2px gap)
Google FedCM errors persist (expected in test environment, low severity)
summary.unique_scenario: Search results listing page card layout responsive analysis — first focused test on zcnc-listing-row card structure (image+info+price stacking), header/nav element responsive behavior, and mobile tap target compliance for nav elements
